extracted.intended_audience: CIA Office of Security staff (Chief, Executive and Planning Division) and administrative/training personnel
extracted.subtask_short: agency memorandum for OMB A-44 reply
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare internal data/memorandum for inclusion in the Office of Security reply implementing OMB Circular A-44 (Revised), describing items under Management Effectiveness and Cost Reduction goals and attaching supporting memoranda.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section I — Management Effectiveness Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Report items under Section I labeled 'Management Effectiveness Goals' — the staff reports one item under this section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include concrete examples of changes that increase management effectiveness (e.g., schedule/timing changes that free personnel to perform other duties). Provide an itemized memorandum from the appropriate branch describing the change and its management impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section II — Cost Reduction Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Report items under Section II labeled 'Cost Reduction Goals'; submit a negative report if no cost reductions occurred.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If changes do not produce cost reductions, explicitly state a negative report for cost reduction while describing other non-cost benefits (such as improved personnel utilization).

rubrics_metrics.name: Itemize Operational Changes and Impacts (Training example)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an attached memorandum that itemizes scheduling and timing changes to a program and the resulting staffing and program effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how the scheduling/timing change altered staffing needs (e.g., one Training Officer can now give the entire program where two were previously required), and state whether this produced cost savings or management effectiveness improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Standard Memorandum Format
rubrics_metrics.description: Communicate the report using the office memorandum format (MEMORANDUM FOR:, SUBJECT:, numbered paragraphs), with attachments as needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Number paragraphs, reference prior memoranda or directives (dates and identifiers), and attach supporting branch memoranda to document facts and conclusions for inclusion in the OS reply.
